preflight.expectedAffectedRows: Create empty canonical context/audit tables and functions; zero compatibility rows are copied, inferred, updated, or removed

execution.resumeStrategy: Expand-only tables/indexes and CREATE OR REPLACE functions are rerunnable; retry the complete transaction
execution.idempotency: IF NOT EXISTS plus CREATE OR REPLACE converge; no session row is created until an authenticated explicit switch

quarantine.strategy: Do not backfill or guess acting organizations; users without a new signed selection receive acting_context_required

constraints: session user/profile/org foreign keys, positive epoch, bounded expiry shape, SHA-256 binding/nonce shape, reasoned revocation
indexes: active user/expiry and org/user session indexes
constraintsAndIndexes.validationPlan: Verify table RLS has no authenticated direct policies, grants expose only own-session RPCs, CAS prevents stale switches, membership/capability changes invalidate resolution, and audit rows remain append-only

recovery.rollback: Keep the additive schema unused and disable signed-context rollout; do not restore unsigned Admin authority or remove session/audit rows
recovery.forwardFix: Ship later additive function/policy corrections and require a new explicit selection after invalidation

queries: table/constraint/index/RLS/grant/function inventory, zero inferred rows, two-session epoch CAS, revoked/expired/membership-changed resolution, and audit action matrix
